description: Generate a health check report for an MCP server's tool manifest. Validates tool definitions against the MCP spec (tool names 1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - .; a tool with no parameters is valid), schema quality and documentation completeness (strict: descriptions ≥ 20 chars, every parameter described). Accepts the answer to tools/list — raw JSON-RPC or its result — or a manifest with name/description. tools/list carries no server name or description, so gate on the tool_quality check rather than on the overall verdict.

manifest.description: MCP server manifest JSON (the response from GET /mcp or tools/list)

strict.description: Enable strict mode: also check for optional best practices (examples, default values, descriptions > 20 chars)

name: mcp_server_health_check
